city_center.name: Church Street Marketplace (Downtown Burlington)
city_center.landmark: Church Street Marketplace pedestrian mall; Lake Champlain waterfront with Adirondack views; Burlington Farmers Market; Green Mountains to the east
city_center.notes: Church Street Marketplace is Burlington's pedestrian brick main street. The city sits on Lake Champlain with the Adirondacks west and the Green Mountains (Stowe, Sugarbush, Bolton Valley, Mad River Glen) a short drive east. sources: churchstmarketplace.com; en.wikipedia.org Burlington, Vermont.
